title: Reproduce the prototype interactions
acceptance:
**Story or goal** · Decide which prototype behaviours can be adopted.

**Expected behaviour** · Replay glass-card flip, folder graphic versus label, nested Back, directional movement and cursor lock in the OneDrive prototype.

**Scope boundary** · Investigate the prototype as a reference for v0.2.

**Previous in delivery queue** · First item in PI-2.

**Depends on** · No PI-2 work-item prerequisite.

**Verify** · Record input, expected and observed result, version and a reuse/adapt/replace decision for each interaction.

**Effort basis** · Verifiability of visual symptoms across inputs.
evidence: scrumWorkspace/documents/PI-02/prototype-replay.md (118 lines) records the replay matrix for the glass flip, folder gestures, nested Back, directional movement and cursor paths with reuse/adapt/replace decisions. The OneDrive FoundationOS-Interface was not present on this machine; the record cites the owner's source-inspection notes in the PI-02 drafts and marks live behaviour as not observable here. Target cursor owns the actionable bounds; keyboard and later controller navigation follow focus. Edge reviewed the document and confirmed the gap statement. Owner accepted PI-02 on 27 November 2026.
